# SMDK Mahal

> A centrally air-conditioned hall for 1,000 guests on the 200 ft road near Retteri Signal — with Sree Varasiddhi Vinayakar temple in the premises.

Website: https://smdkmahal.com/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 74014 07407

## Contact
- SMDK Mahal (Sree M Dasaratha Naidu Kasthuri Mahal) · 200 ft Road, Kolathur, near Retteri Signal, Chennai 600 099 · +91 74014 07407 · info@smdkmahal.com · contact@smdkmahal.com

## Key facts
- 1,000 guests in the A/C hall
- 275 seats in the dining hall
- 12 well-furnished A/C rooms

## Facilities
- Central air-conditioning
- Soundproof hall
- Plasma screens & speakers
- Movable stage
- Marble-floored dining hall
- Ice-cream counter space
- Modern kitchen
- All vessels available
- Vinayakar temple in premises
- Lift
- 100% genset backup
- CCTV & 24-hour security
- Fire safety
- Valet parking

## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can SMDK Mahal hold?
SMDK Mahal seats 1,000 guests in its centrally air-conditioned hall, and 275 in the dining hall.

### Where is SMDK Mahal?
200 ft Road, Kolathur, near Retteri Signal, Chennai 600 099.

### What facilities does SMDK Mahal have?
Central air-conditioning, Soundproof hall, Plasma screens & speakers, Movable stage, Marble-floored dining hall, Ice-cream counter space, Modern kitchen, All vessels available, Vinayakar temple in premises, Lift, 100% genset backup, CCTV & 24-hour security, Fire safety, Valet parking.

### Is non-vegetarian food allowed?
No. Only vegetarian food is permitted at SMDK Mahal.

### What are the check-in and check-out times?
Check-in is at 2.00 p.m. and check-out is at 2.00 p.m. the next day.

### How do I check if SMDK Mahal is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 74014 07407.
